top_signals.title: Fed's Hammack Warns 'Inflationary Mindset' Might Set In
top_signals.summary: Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland President Beth Hammack says she's concerned that an "inflationary mindset" might set in during an event hosted by the bank. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
